title: ShiftRAG: Bypassing the Textual Bottleneck via Decoupled Learning and Continuous Soft Tokens
abstract: arXiv:2611.00871v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite advances in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), suppressing hallucinations during complex reasoning remains a persistent challenge. We identify that existing RAG pipelines suffer from a textual bottleneck: by passing only raw text to the generator, they discard discriminative signals of the retriever. Furthermore, recent attempts to unify retrieval and generation within a single LLM induce severe objective conflict and exacerbate the rank collapse of decoder-only architectures, degrading performance on both tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce ShiftRAG, a decoupled RAG framework that employs a single LLM backbone but isolates discriminative retrieval learning from autoregressive generation. To bridge these decoupled modes, we project retrieval alignments into continuous soft tokens, establishing a high-bandwidth interface that infuses the generator with retrieval-side signals. translated_title: ShiftRAG：通过解耦学习与连续软令牌绕过文本瓶颈
translated_abstract: 尽管检索增强生成（RAG）技术不断进步，但在复杂推理过程中抑制幻觉仍然是一个持续的挑战。我们发现现有的RAG流水线存在文本瓶颈：由于仅将原始文本传递给生成器，它们丢弃了检索器所包含的判别性信号。此外，近期试图将检索与生成统一到单个大语言模型（LLM）中的做法引发了严重的目标冲突，并加剧了仅解码器架构中的秩崩溃问题，导致两项任务的性能均出现下降。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了ShiftRAG，这是一种解耦的RAG框架，它采用单一的大语言模型骨干，但将判别性检索学习与自回归生成分离开来。为了衔接这两种解耦的模式，我们将检索对齐投影为连续软令牌，建立一个高带宽接口，将检索侧的信号注入生成器。同时，我们的软正交性……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ShiftRAG提出了一种解耦的RAG框架，在单一LLM骨干上分离判别性检索学习与自回归生成，并将检索对齐转化为连续软令牌注入生成器，从而绕过文本瓶颈、避免目标冲突，同时提升检索与生成性能。
en_tdlr: ShiftRAG is a decoupled RAG framework that isolates discriminative retrieval learning from autoregressive generation within a single LLM backbone and projects retrieval alignments into continuous soft tokens, bypassing the textual bottleneck to jointly improve retrieval and generation performance.
